featured_reviews.name: Pratik Mhatre
featured_reviews.review_text: Kurla is quiet famous for it's aquarium shops. There are many fish shops and wholesale retailers of aquarium equipment. featured_reviews.review_text: For me, who has been going there since i was a toddler nothing much has changed the same structure, amd those chaos on a friday and sunday its just a great experience. Also it is not as big as Malad's fish market. You can also get it cleaned from them by paying little extra. Sometimes they don't charge for cleaning

featured_reviews.review_text: Nice park. Got some fish tanks. Has a walkway for your morning and evening walks. Surrounded by trees and garden. Sitting area. Workout area. Physical gym. Really nice and Huge area. There is also a a ground for playing crying cketwith a couple of pitches. Also along the side, you will find some drawings on the wall. The only lacking aspect is  toilets. Overall a good place.

featured_reviews.name: tressC
featured_reviews.review_text: I gave it two stars because there's nothing really there! We saw a couple of tanks that had black water in it maybe coz it's unclean. Beyond this you have a beautiful park where families come to enjoy a cool time away from the hustle and bustle of the traffic around. You'll find groups of children playing football, kabadi etc.

featured_reviews.name: Falguni P
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kids Friendly place.
This place is divided into different sections, the entry is free.

*Fish park - this park is quite big and has 3 gates,
The first half has fish tanks, selfie point and a fountain
Currently there are only few fishes, the fountain is shut and the empty tanks are not maintained well (due to COVID)

*The cricket ground - usually there is local cricket match on weekends, chairs are provided for audience.

*Kids play area- there are slides, swings, and play area for kids.

*Open Gym- they have a gym area near the second gate, which is currently closed for public, equipments are mainted nicely.

*Walking / jogging track - there is a long walking and jogging track around the park, local residents usually come visit for morning and evening walks

*Accessibility - park is partially Accessibility as there are stairs in some parts of the park. This place is ideal for kids, family and senior citizens.
The fish park gate is accessible but to reach the other area it is ideal to use the second gate which has a slope.

featured_reviews.name: Cletus Dias
featured_reviews.review_text: The Fish Park was one of my favorite park for walks. Over the years and especially after the pandemic, it has lost its charm. A lot of maintenance is required, tanks are empty and dirty. Unfortunately, people don't respect free places like this and don't support keeping it clean.

featured_reviews.name: Savita Prabhune
featured_reviews.review_text: There are about 10 acquariums. But they need cleaning. The park needs to be maintained. There are fibre decorations in the park those were full of dust. There are selfie points but in dark there is very less light. The acquariums need cleaning and the glass needs wiping.

featured_reviews.name: Lloyd D'souza
featured_reviews.review_text:
The fish park leaves a lot to be desired. There are tanks and there are fish. Neither in the best shape. It’s a wonder the fish are surviving. Needs urgent maintenance.

Entry is free and there is a whole other section with a nice walking track. It’s quiet and peaceful given the location, right next to a busy road and the new metro station.

featured_reviews.review_text: It's become worse. No maintenance and its sad to see the fish in dirty water that doesnt seems to be cleaned since months. The tank filters are choked and dont function well.

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text: It's not a fish market well build, yes but good to go for a fishy foody. The fisher mavshi ate very humble. You need to have good bargaining skills. Else 90% fish is fresh.

featured_reviews.name: Raj Patil
featured_reviews.review_text: You will get variety of fish over here. If you are bargaining king then you will surely get fish at good price. Bhav kami kelach pahije 😀

featured_reviews.name: Kishor Ubale
featured_reviews.review_text: The Fish Market is okay. This is located on Lokmanya Tilak Road mainly said as LT road. I think maximum level of cleanliness is not there but it is obvious we cannot find much cleanliness in place like this as it is a Fish Market. But is small in comparison with Fish Market of Gorai. But What you think about the place is more important. 👍🙌🙌😁

featured_reviews.name: Y V
featured_reviews.review_text: Wide variety of fresh fishes available here. This place is cleaner than any other fish markets around. They open up early at 8 am. There are a lot of cats and kittens here so you can even come here to adopt one if needed.

featured_reviews.name: Chetan Phatak
featured_reviews.review_text: Fresh fish available in vide veraity. Crabs also available. And you can also buy chicken.

featured_reviews.name: baron richie
featured_reviews.review_text: It's nice and accessible via road. Fish is of good quality. Cost is avg or higher side. Cleanliness is less. Expect murk and kichad in rainy season. You may find people lifting their outfits in order to save it from getting soiled

featured_reviews.name: Vinod Shanbhag
featured_reviews.review_text: Enjoy Sunday market
